messages.text: Hi, I’m wondering what the status update is for my order? Order# Shop···· … it was supposed to ship over 2 weeks ago.      Thank you.      Best D. B. forwarded message:      From:  HeliumDeploy <(email hidden)>  Date:  September 18, 2026 at 9:06:12 AM PDT  To:  (email hidden)  Subject:   Order Shop···· confirmed         (email hidden)

Hi Dan,

Your order Shop···· for two Magic M. 40Ts is paid and ships by November 30. I'm sorry it has slipped past the October 31 date you bought on. We gave dates we didn't keep, and that's on us.

The 40T production run had a control board issue. That has been fixed and the final version approved. All 300 units are built and on their way to our warehouses together. We wrote to you about this on November 3, and again on November 8 with photos from the factory visit. If you didn't see those emails, please check your spam folder. It's also worth adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts.

Your tracking number will be emailed to you as soon as your miners ship. Your Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA is included with the order. You can follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
